# Berlin Excel Workshop Planning Snapshot

A 3-hour, beginner-friendly Excel workshop for **12 adults** in **Berlin** can fit your **EUR 900 total** budget if you choose a simple training room, coworking classroom, or community venue with projector access and bring your own trainer/materials.

## Venue Selection Checklist and Sample Agenda

| Area | What to confirm | Target for this booking |
|---|---|---|
| Capacity | Seats for 12 adults with room for laptops | 12 comfortable seats + 1 trainer space |
| Room setup | Tables for hands-on work, projector/screen, power outlets | Classroom or U-shape layout |
| Tech | Reliable Wi‑Fi, HDMI adapter, audio if needed | Stable Wi‑Fi and projector included |
| Accessibility | Step-free access, restrooms, transit proximity | Easy arrival for all participants |
| Time | Access before and after the session | 09:30 setup, 10:00–13:00 workshop |
| Budget | Room + equipment + cleaning + taxes | Stay at or below **EUR 900 total** |
| Catering | Optional water/coffee only, if included | Keep extras minimal |
| Booking terms | Cancellation, invoice, deposit, VAT | Clear written confirmation |
| Learning fit | Quiet space, whiteboard, testable laptops | Good for guided exercises |
| Location | Central Berlin or near transit | Simple access for attendees |

### Sample 10:00–13:00 Agenda

- 10:00–10:15 — Welcome, goals, and Excel setup check
- 10:15–10:35 — Excel basics: interface, cells, sheets, shortcuts
- 10:35–11:05 — Hands-on exercise 1: formatting and simple data entry
- 11:05–11:15 — Short break
- 11:15–11:45 — Formulas basics: SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX
- 11:45–12:20 — Hands-on exercise 2: budget tracker or attendance sheet
- 12:20–12:45 — Sorting, filters, and simple tables
- 12:45–13:00 — Q&A, recap, next steps

## Provider Request Message Template

Subject: Availability and pricing request for Excel workshop venue in Berlin on 12 September 2026

Hello,

I’m looking for a venue in Berlin for a **beginner-friendly Excel workshop** for **12 adults** on **12 September 2026**, from **10:00 to 13:00**.

We need:
- Seating for 12 participants
- Tables suitable for laptop use
- Projector or large screen
- Reliable Wi‑Fi
- Power outlets
- Step-free access if possible

Please share:
- Availability for the date and time above
- Total price, including VAT and any fees
- What is included in the room rental
- Deposit and cancellation terms
- Setup and teardown times
- Whether coffee, water, or catering can be added

Our total budget is **EUR 900**. If you have a room that fits this budget, please send a quote and any relevant room details.

Thank you, and I look forward to your reply.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Phone Number]
[Your Company or Organization]
